svg.title: Vale states the funding condition behind six thick volumes.
svg.desc: Six volumes of conditions fill the foreground as Vale calmly confirms that Golmohar may refuse the trial but would suspend its funds and new post. Ila closes her ledger while Riju holds the terminal close.
svg.text: Page 5, panel 5 · Wide table-level shot with the condition volumes stretching towards camera

text.tspan: Vale confirms that refusal is possible but would
suspend the announced funding and systems post.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
